summary: On June 10-11, 2026, Kimco Realty Corp. announced a proposed private offering and pricing of 3.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2031 by its operating subsidiary, Kimco Realty OP, LLC, to QIBs under Rule 144A. The filing under Item 8.01 describes a debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation event like a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No terms on price per share, premium, or stakeholder changes. This is a routine financing, not a special situation, so it is categorized as None.
